text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just because it is showing a gain; I should weigh its future risk and return against my whole portfolio.","I should not let average cost or reluctance to admit a mistake determine whether I hold or sell; the purchase price does not predict what happens next.","A price drop after I sold Stock D did not prove it was a bargain, just as past price moves do not predict future ones; I should trade only when the current decision makes sense."]}
